instruments.title: School board policies related to changing a pupil's legal name and pronouns (creates s. 118.1255)
instruments.operative_summary: Parent determines the names and pronouns staff may use for a minor pupil; staff may not use a name or pronouns that do not align with biological sex without written authorization from the parent (Assembly Amendment 1, adopted, made it a written NOTARIZED authorization). Also requires the board to try to notify parents before approving a legal-name/pronoun change in official records.
instruments.operative_quote: During school hours, school staff may not refer to a pupil who is a minor by using a name or pronouns that do not align with the pupil's biological sex without written authorization from the pupil's parent or legal guardian.
instruments.rung_note: Consent-first: written (notarized, per AA1) parental authorization before staff use a different name/pronoun. Record-change notice in sub (3)(c) is rung-4-like but secondary.
instruments.status: Passed Assembly 2025-03-20, Senate concurred 2026-02-11, vetoed by Gov. Evers 2026-03-31; 2026-05-13 'failed to pass notwithstanding the Governor's objections under Joint Rule 82' (automatic, no roll call).
instruments.companion: SB 120 (2025) by Sens. Jacque and Tomczyk; no roster sponsors seen

instruments.title: Rights reserved to a parent or guardian of a child ('Parental Bill of Rights', creates s. 48.9865)
instruments.operative_summary: Reserves enumerated rights to parents, enforceable by civil suit; one is the right to determine the names and pronouns used for the child at school. Also notice of 'controversial subjects' (defined to include gender identity), records access.
instruments.operative_quote: The right to determine the names and pronouns used for the child while at school.
instruments.rung_note: Parent, not student, decides the name/pronouns staff use = consent-first in effect; text frames it as a parental right rather than an explicit 'permission before' rule, so coder should confirm. Records-access rights (s. 48.9865(3)(d),(g)) are general, not gender-identity-specific.
instruments.status: Assembly passed 2024-01-18; Senate concurred 2024-02-13; vetoed 2024-03-29; override failed under Joint Rule 82 on 2024-05-15 (automatic, no roll call).
instruments.companion: SB 489 (2023): authors Sens. Wanggaard, Quinn, Marklein, Nass; cosponsors include Reps. Wittke, Schutt, Wichgers. Failed to pass 2024-04-15 (no floor vote). https://docs.legis.wisconsin.gov/2023/proposals/sb489

instruments.title: Rights reserved to a parent or guardian of a child (Parental Bill of Rights, creates s. 48.9865)
instruments.operative_summary: Same model as 2023 AB 510: enumerated parental rights incl. the right to determine names and pronouns used at school; operative text does not mention gender identity.
instruments.operative_quote: The right to determine the names and pronouns used for the child while at school.
instruments.status: Assembly passed 2022-02-22; Senate concurred 2022-03-08; vetoed 2022-04-15; override failed under Joint Rule 82 on 2022-05-17 (no roll call).

roll_calls.note: Paired 2 (Penterman aye / Shankland nay). Schutt and Cruz not in Assembly then.

own_words.quote: I've always said you shouldn't have to legislate common sense, but apparently we have to here. Of course parents should have the right to determine the name and religion of their child, and see their medical records. Unfortunately, some school districts and health care providers think differently, making this bill necessary.
own_words.note: Press release 2024-02-13 from his Senate office, named speaker. Same release states 'parents have the right to determine the name and pronoun used by their child at school' (narrator text, not quoted). Also his 11/8/2023 committee testimony lists 'The right to determine the names and pronouns used for the child while at school' (LC hearing materials PDF, https://docs.legis.wisconsin.gov/misc/lc/hearing_testimony_and_materials/2023/ab510/ab0510_2023_11_08.pdf, page 2).

direction_only.note: Voted No on AB 103 (2025), AB 510 (2023, sv0263), AB 963 (2021, sv0326). Co-offered Senate Substitute Amendment 1 to AB 510 (content not read).

Voted No on AB 103 (2025), AB 510 (2023, av0139), AB 963 (2021, av0209). A WisPolitics statement (https://www.wispolitics.com/?p=318746) says AB 510 is not about parents' rights but is paywalled — not fetched. Spectrum News 2025-03-20 quotes her on trans health care/sports, not on notification.

Lead author of AB 510 (record, see instruments). His own 11/8/2023 testimony (PDF p.1) frames the bill as 'really about transparency' and lists notice/records rights, but does NOT mention names/pronouns — own words give no rung beyond the authorship.

2025-03-20 floor remark joking about his name and pronouns; CapTimes 2025-03-26 quotes him saying the bills let the public tell Evers 'he's wrong'. Neither states a rung. Record: Yes votes on AB 963, AB 510, AB 103.
